sloka: कर्तव्यम् सुमहत् कर्म सुराणाम् राज सूनुना ।एवम् उक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुर् हृष्टा विहायसम् ॥१-२६-३१॥
transliteration: kartavyam sumahat karma surāṇām rāja sūnunā ।evam uktvā surāḥ sarve jagmur hṛṣṭā vihāyasam ॥1-26-31॥

translations.english: Having said these words, the celestials were pleased. They honoured Viswamitra and returned to their abodes from where they had come. And then dusk set in.
